body.content:
Hi Bharath,

Following up on your request, please find attached the available closeout
documentation for the iSMASH Everett project.

The package includes:

  1. **Final Invoice and Payment Application:**  Invoice #5 for $52,184.44, including the AIA G702 showing the original contract value, approved change orders, previous payment certificates, and remaining balance.

  2. **Carney Conditional Final Lien Waiver:**  Covering the outstanding final payment of $52,184.44.

  3. **Onesta Unconditional Final Lien Waiver:**  Signed and notarized, confirming $433,979.97 in payments received.

  4. **Subcontractor Lien Waivers:**  27 waivers documenting $195,455.26 in subcontractor payments.

  5. **HVAC Air Balance Report:**  Omni Mechanical's June 8, 2026 report documenting airflow testing and balancing throughout the facility.

The updated punch list was sent last week.

We balanced the working Hvac unit and attached it

Our final payment application reflects a total contract value of $521,026.69,
with $468,842.25 in previous payment certificates and a final balance of
$52,184.44.

Please send payment per our contract at CO and we will schedule the final few
items.

Thank you,

Troy Fink

Client Relations

Carney Contracting Services, Inc.

405 Estates Ct.

Newtown, PA 18940

C: 215-906-3474

Hi Jeff, Troy, and Michael,

Thank you for sending the final invoice for $52,184.44. I am reviewing it and
would like to coordinate the remaining work and closeout documentation.

  

Please provide the following:

  1. **Punch-list closeout.**  Thank you, Troy, for providing the updated punch-list dates. Please confirm which scheduled items have now been completed, flag any changes to the dates already provided, and confirm completion dates for any remaining undated items. Please coordinate any work after opening with us to minimize disruption.

  2. **HVAC closeout records.** The immediate HVAC component failures is being looked into. Please provide any diagnostic or service records in Carney’s or Onesta’s possession, any test-and-balance report, and confirmation whether final HVAC adjustment and balancing under Carney’s scope has been completed. If anything remains, please provide the completion date. Last week, i had called out the heat is not balanced. Please have this checked across all the rooms

  3. **Final account reconciliation.**  Please provide a statement showing the original contract amount, approved change orders, payments received, applicable credits, and calculation of the remaining balance. Please also provide the itemized receipts and supplier/subcontractor invoices supporting the latest change order, which I have not yet received.

  4. **Lien documentation.** Please provide Carney’s conditional final lien waiver required under the agreement, together with subcontractor/supplier payment status and available releases for amounts already paid. Please identify any outstanding balances and the arrangements for obtaining the corresponding releases upon payment.

  5. **Lien documentation and final-disbursement process.** Before final disbursement, please provide:

     1. Carney’s conditional final lien waiver under §9.4.1 and Exhibit E;

     2. a final accounting identifying every subcontractor and supplier, amounts paid, and balances remaining;

     3. unconditional lien releases for all amounts already paid; and

     4. conditional final lien waivers from each subcontractor or supplier whose balance will be paid through the final disbursement.

Please also confirm that, after the final payment clears, Carney will provide
unconditional final lien releases from Carney, Onesta, and every subcontractor
or supplier paid through that disbursement. If any party cannot provide the
applicable waiver or release, please identify that party and amount now so the
lender can arrange a joint-check or other controlled-payment process.

  6. **Warranty and handover package.** Please provide all written warranties, equipment manuals, applicable inspection/testing records and the Substantial Completion certificate. Please confirm the warranty start/end dates, Carney’s warranty contact and the local contractors who will handle service requests.

  

After receiving and reviewing this documentation and confirming the status of
the outstanding work, I will coordinate the lender’s final inspection and
payment process in accordance with our agreement and the lender’s
requirements.

Receipt of the Certificate of Occupancy and final invoice does not constitute
acceptance of unresolved work, approval of the stated balance, confirmation
that final payment is presently due, or waiver of any rights or claims.

Thanks,  
Bharath

message.subject: Base-Rent Commencement date

body.content:
Hi Alex,

  

Thank you again for completing the exterior stair work and helping us obtain
the final Certificate of Occupancy on November 3.

  

I am asking you to reconsider our earlier request and extend the current Base
Rent abatement for aleast three additional months, covering December 1, 2026
through February 28, 2027, with Base Rent commencing April 1, 2027. We would
continue paying NNN, utilities and other applicable Additional Rent during
this period.

  

The fire alarm work took approximately 142 days - April-to-August. During
substantial portions of this period, critical-path tenant work—including
closure of the affected ceilings and progress toward final inspections—was
materially delayed.

  

We have made a substantial investment in the premises and incurred significant
carrying costs while being unable to operate. A three to four month extension
would help the new business stabilize after these construction and compliance
delays while preserving the long-term landlord-tenant relationship.

  

Please reconsider allowing Base Rent to commence on April 1, 2027. We would
document the revised commencement date in a short written lease amendment
before December 1.

  

Thank you for considering this request. I would be happy to discuss it with
you directly.

  

Best regards,

Bharath

Smash District, LLC
